{{Top|leg}}
'''Parasite droids''' were a classification of [[Spy droid/Legends|spy droid]] used around the time of the [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances]]. [[Drikl Lecersen]] supplied the [[Journalist/Legends|journalist]] [[Javis Tyrr]] with one parasite droid, integrated within a [[Lovolol cleaning droid]].
